summary: The cat mapping remains visually clear under both joint methods. For guitar, joint subspace erases the guitar but does not show stable pianos, whereas the Eq. 6 ablation produces recognizable piano keys or pianos in most seeds. Candidate-set CLIP top-1 therefore overstates visual correspondence for joint subspace.

mappings.observation: Joint subspace shows recognizable dogs in all ten seeds. Eq. 6 also mostly shows dogs, with a few more cat-like facial or body traits.

Joint subspace mostly shows walls, windows, textures, or unrelated scenes rather than pianos. Eq. 6 shows recognizable keyboards or pianos in most seeds, with a small number of partial or ambiguous cases.
